title: Stardust with and without humming
summary: On tape he plays a Stardust phrase alternately with and without singing, saying humming makes it easier.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, I was wondering, could you play your -- just for -- just to show the difference, could you play the -- any kind of a variation on that famous "Stardust" solo that you played without singing and then play it with singing?
Sure. I mean, at least I'll try.

(Playing bass.) Start off singing, like (playing bass). No sing. (Playing bass). Sing. (Playing bass). No sing. (Playing bass). Sing. (Playing bass). No sing. (Playing bass). Sing. (Playing bass). If you notice, you probably have the same feeling that I have. I feel more at home when I'm singing with it, you know? It makes it a little -- very easy, much easier for me, because I'm used to --
Yeah, because you've been doing it for so long.
